scene sky
I tap on Kaori’s name in my phone and wait for her to answer because, despite how long we’ve known each other, I don’t think she’s ever come to my house yet.
lines.zh: 我在手机里点下 Kaori 的名字，等她接 —— 因为尽管我们认识这么久了，我觉得她还从没来过我家。

lines.en: Which is obviously something I both can and {i}will{/i} change now that she is also some sort of sex-friend to me.
lines.zh: 这显然是我既能改变、也{i}一定会{/i}改变的事，毕竟她现在也算是我某种意义上的性朋友了。

lines.en: And, while I suppose it’s possible this could be misconstrued as me taking advantage of her...peculiar intellect and overall naiveté for my own personal gain, I have one thing to say about that.
lines.zh: 当然，我知道这可能会被误解成我在利用她那……古怪的智力和整体的天真来为自己谋利，对此我只有一句话要说。

lines.en: So what?
lines.zh: 那又怎样？

lines.en: It’s not like she doesn’t {i}like{/i} having sex. And it’s not {i}my{/i} civic duty to instill societal norms within her while she’s blissfully ignorant of all of them.
lines.zh: 她又不是不{i}喜欢{/i}做爱。而且她对这些社会规范一无所知、过得也挺幸福，{i}我{/i}没有义务非要灌输给她。

lines.en: Plus, both Niki and Ami are out of the house until later tonight and I must seize this opportunity now, for I do not know when the next time I will get such a good chance to fuck her in the comfort of my own bedroom is.
lines.zh: 再说，Niki 和 Ami 今晚很晚才回来，我必须抓住这个机会，因为我不知道下次还能不能在自家卧室舒舒服服地干她了。

lines.en: : Friend! How do you feel about shrimp?
lines.zh: : 朋友！你对虾有什么看法？

lines.en: : Shrimp?
: Sorry — I meant to say micro-legfish. Did you know that they do not turn pink until they are delicious? {i}Regular{/i} micro-legfish are actually a greyish-
lines.zh: : 抱歉 —— 我想说的是「微腿鱼」。你知道吗，它们要等到变得美味的时候才会变成粉色？{i}普通{/i}的微腿鱼其实是灰——

lines.en: : Yes, I know all about micro-legfish. What are you doing right now?
lines.zh: : 是的，微腿鱼我全都知道。你现在在做什么？

lines.en: : Telephone!
lines.zh: : 打电话！

lines.en: : Okay. What were you doing {i}before{/i} I called?
lines.zh: : 好吧。我打来{i}之前{/i}你在做什么？

lines.en: : Do you remember the store you came to just one time many years ago where I served you the large hot dairy circle?
lines.zh: : 你还记得好多年前你只来过一次的那家店吗？我在那儿给你端上了那个又大又热的奶制品圆环。

lines.en: : Vaguely, but only because it was really close to my house. That was all the way back in chapter one though and I didn’t think it would ever be relevant again.
lines.zh: : 隐约记得，只因为那家店离我家特别近。不过那都是第一章的事了，我以为它再也不会被提起。

lines.en: : Well, it is! Because I am there — serving large hot dairy circles to people less prone to human trafficking. Why did you press my name button?
lines.zh: : 嗯，现在有关了！因为我正待在那儿 —— 给那些不太容易被人口贩卖的人端上又大又热的奶制品圆环。你为什么按我的名字按钮？

lines.en: : Because I want you to come over here and hang out with me.
lines.zh: : 因为我想让你过来陪我。

lines.en: : For sexual purposes?
lines.zh: : 是为了做那种事吗？

lines.en: : That’s part of it, yes.
lines.zh: : 算是其中一部分吧，对。

lines.en: : Yay!
lines.zh: : 好耶！

lines.en: : Uhh...yay?
lines.zh: : 呃……好耶？

lines.en: : My work becomes worked in three hundred seconds. After that, I will come to your housebox and spread my legs so you can-
lines.zh: : 我的工作在三百秒后就被工作完了。之后我会去你的房子箱，然后张开腿，好让你——

lines.en: : Yup. No need to go over it in detail while you’re still at work. I’ll just send you my address and-
lines.zh: : 对对。你还上着班呢，不用讲那么细。我直接把地址发给你——

lines.en: : There is no need! Hello!
lines.zh: : 不需要！你好！

lines.en: : Kaori? Are you still-
lines.zh: : Kaori？你还在——

lines.en: scene black
I’m just not even going to ask why she doesn’t need my address. I’m sure she has her reasons.
lines.zh: 她为什么不需要我的地址，我连问都不想问了。她肯定有她的理由。

lines.en: And I’m sure they wouldn’t make much sense to me either way.
lines.zh: 而且我敢肯定，不管怎样，那些理由我也听不懂。

lines.en: scene kaorivisits1
: Friend! I have arrived. And I am ready to be penised now.
lines.zh: : 朋友！我到了。我已经准备好被阴茎进入了。

lines.en: : We’re not supposed to do that in the doorway.
lines.zh: : 我们不该在门口做这个。

lines.en: scene kaorivisits2
: Because others passing the by will become gelatinous upon watching my girl-hole be pierced by an attractive man’s cock muscle?
lines.zh: : 因为路过的人看到我的少女洞被一个帅气男人的鸡巴肌贯穿，会变成胶状物？

lines.en: : Yup. So why don’t you just come inside first?
lines.zh: : 没错。所以你要不要先进来？

lines.en: : I am confused. Do I do the penising this time? I thought you were the one who cums inside?
lines.zh: : 我糊涂了。这次是由我来阴茎吗？我以为射在里面的是你？

lines.en: : Kaori, no. Come inside {i}my house.{/i}
lines.zh: : Kaori，不是。是进{i}我家{/i}里面。

lines.en: scene kaorivisits3
: The whole thing?! How virile do you think I am?!
lines.zh: : 要进整个房子？！你以为我有多旺盛啊？！

lines.en: Today is going to be a long day, isn't it?
lines.zh: 今天会是漫长的一天，对吧？

lines.en: scene kaorivisits4
I eventually manage to get Kaori inside of the house, where it only takes about five seconds for her to start freaking out about every single item she sees.
lines.zh: 我总算把 Kaori 弄进了屋，结果才过了五秒钟，她就开始对看到的每一样东西大惊小怪。

lines.en: : Such a large box of temperature!
lines.zh: : 好大的一箱温度！

lines.en: : Refrigerator.
lines.zh: : 冰箱。

lines.en: scene kaorivisits5
: Refri...refur..re...ri...refrigeratoror?
lines.zh: : 冰……冰香……冰……箱……冰箱箱？

lines.en: : Why did you say it in English?
lines.zh: : 你为什么用英语说？

lines.en: : Comedy.
lines.zh: : 喜剧效果。

lines.en: scene kaorivisits6
: Why is this shadow so strange? What happened to it? Is your housebox magical, Friend? Is it the cum that gives it power?
lines.zh: : 这个影子为什么这么奇怪？它怎么了？你的房子箱有魔法吗，朋友？是精液给了它力量吗？

lines.en: : I think that’s just a rendering issue. They’re all over the place and I highly doubt it will change so long as we’re confined to whatever fate grants us our third dimension.
lines.zh: : 我觉得那只是渲染问题。到处都是，而且我高度怀疑，只要我们被困在赐予我们第三维度的那个命运里，它就不会变。

lines.en: scene kaorivisits7

: {size=-12}Speaking of dimensions, did you know that the fourth dimension typically refers to time? And that the combination of this plus the three dimensions that make up reality or the “space” that we inhabit combine to form spacetime? Which is a much different thing than just what time it is in space. But also it can refer to a hypothetical dimension perpendicular to ours in which ideas like the “tesseract” would allow us to see all sides of a three-dimensional object at once.{/size}
lines.zh: : {size=-12}说到维度，你知道第四维度通常指的是时间吗？而这个时间，加上构成现实、也就是我们所居住的「空间」的那三个维度，合在一起就形成了时空？这和「太空中现在是几点」是完全不同的概念。不过它也可以指一个与我们垂直的假想维度 —— 在那个维度里，像「超立方体」这样的概念能让我们同时看见一个三维物体的所有面。{/size}

lines.en: scene kaorivisits8
: Where does this door go?
lines.zh: : 这扇门通向哪里？

lines.en: : That’s-
lines.zh: : 那是——

lines.en: : I...actually don’t think I’ve ever noticed that before.
lines.zh: : 我……其实觉得我以前从来没注意过那扇门。

lines.en: scene kaorivisits9
: Is this also a rendering issue? Like your special magic cum-plant?
lines.zh: : 这也是渲染问题吗？就像你那株特别的魔法精液植物一样？

lines.en: : Hey, here’s an idea. Why don’t we check out the living room next? There are fewer shiny objects for you to get sidetracked by there.
lines.zh: : 嘿，我有个主意。我们接下来去客厅怎么样？那儿闪亮的东西少一些，你就不会分心了。

lines.en: : “Living room” implies the existence of a “dying room.” Please do not murderburger me. I have only just recently learned what it means to live at all.
lines.zh: : 「客厅」暗示着「死厅」的存在。请不要谋杀堡我。我才刚刚学会「活着」是什么意思。

lines.en: scene kaorivisits10
: You were right about the shadows here, Friend. Your home is not so much a “house” as it is a “how?”
lines.zh: : 你对这儿影子的判断是对的，朋友。你的家与其说是「房子」，不如说是个「怎么？」。

lines.en: : This whole world is a “how?” My house is just the small section of said world that I set aside to masturbate and sleep.
lines.zh: : 这整个世界都是一个「怎么？」。我的家只是这个世界里、我专门留出来打飞机和睡觉的一小块地方。

lines.en: : And the smaller, redder human lives here too? Or have you finished trafficking her?
lines.zh: : 那个更小、更红的人类也住在这儿吗？还是说你已经把她贩卖完了？

lines.en: : Ami still lives here, yeah. Though, I’m not exactly sure if she {i}should{/i} at this point.
lines.zh: : Ami 还住在这儿，是啊。不过到了现在，我也不太确定她{i}应{/i}不该住这儿。

lines.en: : Then I suppose she should be lucky you have not yet showed her the dying room. I wonder if that is where your mystery door leads?
lines.zh: : 那我想她该庆幸你还没带她去看那个死厅。我在想，你那扇神秘门是不是就通向那儿？

lines.en: : Kaori, can I ask you something?
lines.zh: : Kaori，我能问你件事吗？

lines.en: : Is it about bees?
lines.zh: : 是关于蜜蜂的吗？

lines.en: : No.
lines.zh: : 不是。

lines.en: : Then I am a little upset, but you can ask me anyway since we are friends and I like how you feel inside of me.
lines.zh: : 那我有点失望，不过你还是可以问，因为我们是朋友，而且我喜欢你在我里面的感觉。

lines.en: : I was just wondering what you’d do if Nao started acting...different one day.
lines.zh: : 我只是想知道，如果有一天 Nao 开始变得……不一样了，你会怎么办。

lines.en: : Different how?
lines.zh: : 怎么个不一样？

lines.en: : Like scary and intimidating and powerful and just all around insane with no desire to change or even acknowledge the negative impact she is making on your life and overall existence.
lines.zh: : 比如可怕、吓人、强势，整个人都疯了，而且根本没有改变的意愿，甚至不承认她正在对你的生活、对你的整个存在造成负面影响。

lines.en: : Is this about Thomas Two-Tongues?
lines.zh: : 这是关于双舌 Thomas 的事吗？

lines.en: scene kaorivisits11
: Hm...this is a difficult question to answer, Friend. For I can not imagine a Nao-chan who is not a perfect little daughterbug.
lines.zh: : 嗯……这个问题很难回答，朋友。因为我无法想象一个不是完美小女儿虫的 Nao 酱。

lines.en: : Has your red child begun to scare you for some reason?
lines.zh: : 你的红色小孩是不是因为什么原因开始让你害怕了？

lines.en: : Kind of. She just...doesn’t listen to me anymore. And every day, she’s getting more and more bold with how she decides to make my life Hell.
lines.zh: : 有点。她就是……再也不听我的话了。而且每一天，她在把我的人生变成地狱这件事上都越来越大胆。

lines.en: scene kaorivisits12
: But you love her too much to cut her into ribbons?
lines.zh: : 可你太爱她了，舍不得把她切成碎条？

lines.en: : That’s not how I’d word it, but yeah. I just don’t really know what to do. I want things to be like how they were in the past, but...
lines.zh: : 我不会这么说，不过……是的。我只是真不知道该怎么办。我想让一切回到过去的样子，可是……

lines.en: : But the future won’t become the past until much later.
lines.zh: : 但要等到很久以后，未来才会变成过去。

lines.en: : Yeah...
lines.zh: : 是啊……

lines.en: scene kaorivisits13
: Wait, what?
lines.zh: : 等等，什么？

lines.en: : Your pants keep buzzing, Friend. Are you {i}sure{/i} you don’t want to ask me about bees?
lines.zh: : 你的裤子一直在嗡嗡响，朋友。你{i}确定{/i}不想问我关于蜜蜂的事吗？

lines.en: : I don’t have any questions about bees, Kaori.
lines.zh: : 我对蜜蜂没有任何问题，Kaori。

lines.en: : Okaaaaay. But if you are keeping them in your pants, it is probably a bad idea.
lines.zh: : 好————吧。不过如果你把蜜蜂养在裤子里，那大概不是个好主意。

lines.en: : That’s my phone. And it’s probably just “the red child” again, so give me a second to talk to her and then I will gift you with the penising you so desire.
lines.zh: : 那是我的手机。而且大概又是「那个红色小孩」，所以给我一点时间跟她说两句，然后我就赐你这般渴望的阴茎之礼。

lines.en: : Okay. I will wait here and think about which words I will use during the penising while you transmit your unease through a rectangular talk-box that is definitely not just bees.
lines.zh: : 好的。我就在这儿等着，顺便想想阴茎的时候该用哪些词，而你则通过一个长方形的说话盒子传递你的不安 —— 那盒子绝对不只是蜜蜂。

lines.en: : ...Right.
scene black
scene kaorivisits14
: Ami?
lines.zh: : Ami？

lines.en: : Do I really come across as scary and intimidating and powerful and just all around insane with no desire to change or even acknowledge the negative impact I am making on your life and overall existence?
lines.zh: : 我真的给人那种可怕、吓人、强势、整个人都疯了的感觉吗？还毫无改变的意愿，甚至不承认我正对你的生活、对你的整个存在造成负面影响？

lines.en: scene kaorivisits15
: Oh...good. So you’ve bugged the house too.
lines.zh: : 哦……不错。这么说你连家里也装了窃听器。

lines.en: : The house, your phone, maybe even your glasses. Or maybe I’ve just implanted some sort of chip in your brain that transmits all your thoughts directly to me! Who knows at this point?
lines.zh: : 家里、你的手机，说不定连你的眼镜都有。也可能我只是在你脑子里植入了某种芯片，把你所有的想法直接传给我！谁知道呢，到了这个时候？

lines.en: : So I just have no privacy at all anymore?
lines.zh: : 所以我一点隐私都没有了？

lines.en: : I give you plenty of privacy. But this pertains directly to me and I don’t want you feeling that way anymore. So yes, I’ve decided to interrupt your date to try and nip this in the bud.
lines.zh: : 我给了你很多隐私。但这件事直接关系到我，我不想让你再那样想我了。所以没错，我决定打断你的约会，好把这事扼杀在摇篮里。

lines.en: : By making yourself look even crazier? Solid strategy, I’ve gotta say.
lines.zh: : 方式是让自己看起来更疯？这策略真高明，我得说。

lines.en: : I’m glad you’re trying, Dad. It really does mean a lot.
lines.zh: : 我很高兴你在努力，爸爸。这真的意义重大。

lines.en: : I know I can be a handful. Ten handfuls even. So many handfuls that it would take a brand new god to even hold me. But I don’t want to {i}scare{/i} you. I love you.
lines.zh: : 我知道我很难搞。甚至是十倍难搞。难搞到需要一个全新的神才能抱住我。可我不想{i}吓到{/i}你。我爱你。

lines.en: : I know you’re still there. I can see you too.
lines.zh: : 我知道你还在。我也能看见你。

lines.en: : You’re playing with me....and I want you to stop.
lines.zh: : 你在玩我……而我要你停下。

lines.en: : You’re playing with me too. We’re playing with each other. It’s like a game! How crazy is that?
lines.zh: : 你也在玩我啊。我们在互相玩。就像一场游戏！多疯狂，是不是？

lines.en: : That’s just what we do, though. And I don’t hold it against you, so you shouldn’t hold it against me. Just be happy we’re playing together at all! I know I am.
lines.zh: : 可我们就是这样啊。我不怪你，所以你也不该怪我。能一起玩就该高兴了！我反正很高兴。

lines.en: : Are you really, though?
lines.zh: : 你真的高兴吗？

lines.en: : No.
: But this just proves you know when I’m lying.
lines.zh: : 但这正好证明，你能看出来我在撒谎。

lines.en: : Now, take that and apply it to everything {i}else.{/i}
lines.zh: : 现在，把这一点套用到{i}其他{/i}所有事情上。

lines.en: : Maybe then, you’ll get it.
lines.zh: : 也许那样，你就能明白了。

lines.en: : Anyway, love you! I have tables waiting. Chika’s absence is really fattening my wallet. I’m going to buy so many more spycams!
lines.zh: : 总之，爱你！我还有几桌客人等着。Chika 不在真是让我的钱包鼓起来了。我要去买好多好多新的针孔摄像头！

lines.en: scene black
I hang up the phone and begin to come to terms with something I’ve probably always known — that even my home isn’t safe for me anymore.
lines.zh: 我挂了电话，开始接受一件我大概早就知道的事 —— 就连我的家，对我来说也不再安全了。

lines.en: This small part of this terrible world I’ve set aside for the things I mentioned earlier is now but one more prison I will lock myself inside because I don’t know where else to go.
lines.zh: 这个糟糕的世界里、我专门留出来做前面说的那些事的一小块地方，如今也不过是又一座我要把自己关进去的监狱，因为我不知道还能去哪儿。

lines.en: Or maybe I just {i}like{/i} being watched?
lines.zh: 又或者，我只是{i}喜欢{/i}被人看着？

lines.en: She gets that from her mother, I’m sure. And if Ami were to die next, I’m sure she’d haunt me too.
lines.zh: 这一点肯定是她妈遗传的。要是下一个死的是 Ami，我敢肯定她也会来缠着我。

lines.en: But she feels different than Sekai did.
lines.zh: 但她的感觉和 Sekai 不一样。

lines.en: Because for all her flaws, it never seemed like she {i}wanted{/i} to hurt me.
lines.zh: 因为她尽管一身毛病，却从来没有像是{i}要{/i}伤害我的样子。

lines.en: And I’m just not sure if that’s true when it comes to this daughter of mine.
lines.zh: 而对于我这个女儿，我就不确定是不是这样了。

lines.en: scene kaorivisits16
: Kaori?...
lines.zh: : Kaori？……

lines.en: I’m not sure of anything anymore.
lines.zh: 我现在什么都不确定了。

lines.en: scene kaorivisits17
scene black
scene kaorivisits18
: Kaori...I didn’t give you permission to wander around my house unsupervised. You’re not supposed to be-
lines.zh: : Kaori……我没允许你在我家里、没人看着的情况下乱逛。你不该在——

lines.en: : What is this, Friend?...
lines.zh: : 这是什么，朋友？……

lines.en: : What’s what? This is Ami’s room. And, like I was saying, you’re not supposed to be in here.
lines.zh: : 什么什么？这是 Ami 的房间。而且就像我刚才说的，你不该进来。

lines.en: : But why does it feel like this?...
lines.zh: : 可为什么感觉会是这样？……

lines.en: : The colors. The smell. The air here is suffocating. But for some reason...
lines.zh: : 这些颜色。这个气味。这里的空气让人窒息。可是出于某种原因……

lines.en: : I can’t bring myself to leave.
lines.zh: : 我怎么也走不出去。

lines.en: : It’s like I’ve been here before...
lines.zh: : 就像我以前来过这里……

lines.en: scene kaorivisits19
: My heart...it’s beating so quickly...but not for the reasons it was in the room of the living.
lines.zh: : 我的心脏……跳得好快……但不是在那个活人的房间里时那种原因。

lines.en: : It beats as if it’s trying to escape.
lines.zh: : 它跳得像是要逃出去一样。

lines.en: : I want to pull it out and show it that everything is fine.
lines.zh: : 我想把它掏出来，让它看看一切都没事。

lines.en: : It hurts so much...
lines.zh: : 好疼……

lines.en: : I want to die.
lines.zh: : 我想死。

lines.en: scene kaorivisits20
: What, was the first time not enough for you?
lines.zh: : 怎么，第一次还不够吗？

lines.en: scene kaorivisits21
: Right...
lines.zh: : 对了……

lines.en: : I’m already dead...
lines.zh: : 我已经死了……

lines.en: : I...forgot for a moment...
lines.zh: : 我……有一瞬间忘了……

lines.en: : I’m not sure if I believe that. In fact, I imagine you’re the reason she barged in here at all.
lines.zh: : 我不知道该不该信。事实上，我猜她之所以闯进这儿，就是你造成的。

lines.en: : It feels so much different with a body...
lines.zh: : 有身体的感觉完全不同……

lines.en: : Being here...even when she isn’t home...it all feels so real...
lines.zh: : 待在这儿……就算她不在家……一切都感觉好真实……

lines.en: : Because it {i}is.{/i}
lines.zh: : 因为它本来{i}就是{/i}。

lines.en: : The world kept going after you left. Which is why having you keep coming back like this is painful for {i}me.{/i}
lines.zh: : 你走之后，世界还在继续。所以你这样一次次回来，对{i}我{/i}来说很痛。

lines.en: : You’re not supposed to be here, Sekai...
lines.zh: : 你不该在这里，Sekai……

lines.en: : No, Aki-kun....
lines.zh: : 不，Aki 君……

lines.en: : It’s painful because I {i}am{/i} supposed to be here.
lines.zh: : 之所以痛，是因为我{i}本该{/i}在这里。

lines.en: : Making breakfasts. Sending her off to school with a smile. Tucking her into bed at night. Cutting her hair. Teaching her everything you {i}can’t{/i} because you’re not {i}me.{/i}
lines.zh: : 做早饭。笑着送她上学。晚上给她盖好被子。给她剪头发。教她所有你{i}教不了{/i}的事，因为你不是{i}我{/i}。

lines.en: : {size=-2}Take me...carve me open...and wrap the heart trapped in this hopeless vessel so tightly in my daughter’s sheets that I’ll be able to trick myself into thinking, even if only for a moment, that she sleeps within my arms again.{/size}
lines.zh: : {size=-2}把我带走……把我剖开……把这具绝望躯壳里困住的心，用我女儿的床单裹得那么紧，紧到我能骗自己相信 —— 哪怕只有一瞬间 —— 她又睡在我的怀里了。{/size}

lines.en: : Please don’t pass your suicidal tendencies onto other people. That body isn’t yours to sacrifice, no matter how badly you may want to.
lines.zh: : 请别把你的自杀倾向传染给别人。那具身体不是你可以拿来牺牲的，不管你有多想。

lines.en: : Sacrifice?...
: Is just wanting to {i}rest{/i} really so sacrificial?...
lines.zh: : 只是想{i}休息{/i}一下，真的算得上牺牲吗？……

lines.en: : I never asked for this. I never asked for any of it. But {i}here{/i} it is. Right in front of me. Teasing me. Taunting me.
lines.zh: : 这一切我从来没求过。我从来没求过任何一件事。可它就这么摆在{i}那儿{/i}。就在我面前。逗弄我。嘲弄我。

lines.en: : I’m not just a ghost this time. I’m me. I’m here.
lines.zh: : 这一次我不只是个幽灵。我是我。我在这里。

lines.en: : I’m really {i}here...{/i}
lines.zh: : 我真的{i}在这里{/i}……

lines.en: : We should get out of here...I called {i}Kaori{/i} here, not my dearly-departed ex-lover.
lines.zh: : 我们该离开这儿了……我叫来的是 {i}Kaori{/i}，不是我已故的旧情人。

lines.en: : Just a little while longer...please...
lines.zh: : 再待一小会儿……求你了……

lines.en: : Sekai-
lines.zh: : Sekai——

lines.en: : {i}Please...{/i}
: I beg you...
lines.zh: : 我求你……

lines.en: : Let me stay...
lines.zh: : 让我留下来……

lines.en: scene black
I should have thought of this...
lines.zh: 我本该想到的……

lines.en: I don’t know why or...{i}how{/i} I didn’t.
lines.zh: 我不知道为什么，或者说……{i}怎么会{/i}没想到。

lines.en: Just...all those moments where she {i}was{/i} here felt more real to me since I could see her. {i}Feel{/i} her.
lines.zh: 只是……她{i}在{/i}这里的那些时刻，对我来说都更真实，因为我看得见她。{i}摸得到{/i}她。

lines.en: But I never considered how she felt.
lines.zh: 可我从来没想过她是什么感受。

lines.en: If she could even feel at all, the way she is.
lines.zh: 如果以她现在的样子，她还能有感觉的话。

lines.en: And...
lines.zh: 而且……

lines.en: It’s the same thing I did with her daughter...
lines.zh: 这和我对待她女儿是同一件事……

lines.en: scene kaorivisits22
My selfishness has extended so far in the midst of my dolor that it has overtaken everything else and turned each fruit from my tree into fuel for my fleeting desires.
lines.zh: 我的自私在我的悲痛之中延伸得如此之远，已经吞没了一切，把我树上结出的每一颗果实都变成了转瞬即逝的欲望的燃料。

lines.en: This is exactly how it felt so, so long ago. The only difference is I’m bigger now. And I would not be crushed under the weight of both her body and her misery as I can surely now contend with both.
lines.zh: 这感觉和很久很久以前一模一样。唯一的区别是我现在长大了。我不会再被她的身体和她的痛苦一起压垮，因为现在的我肯定能同时承受两者。

lines.en: But if {i}I{/i} were to be held captive, in ways unlike the ways in which I am, I’m sure the despair would be malignant. That this pain would be {i}nothing{/i} compared to how it would feel in shoes that don’t fit.
lines.zh: 可如果换一种方式被囚禁，我敢肯定那份绝望会是恶性的。而现在这份痛苦，比起穿一双不合脚的鞋，根本{i}算不了什么{/i}。

lines.en: So I give her the time she needs. The time to wallow.
lines.zh: 所以我把她需要的时间给她。用来沉溺的时间。

lines.en: To stare at the floor and imagine the feet that grace it during late-night trips to the sink to fetch a glass of water.
lines.zh: 盯着地板，想象深夜起身去水槽接一杯水时，踏过它的那双脚。

lines.en: Or those that scamper hurriedly across the wood each weekday morning starting at 5:00 AM on the dot so she can make sure {i}I{/i} don’t leave this prison hungry.
lines.zh: 或者每个工作日早上五点整，准时急匆匆踩过木地板的那双脚 —— 好确保{i}我{/i}不会饿着离开这座监狱。

lines.en: If Sekai were still alive, Ami would be able to sleep in.
lines.zh: 如果 Sekai 还活着，Ami 就能睡个懒觉了。

lines.en: What a simple thought to end on.
lines.zh: 用这么简单的念头作结。

lines.en: : You know, Aki-kun...
lines.zh: : 你知道吗，Aki 君……

lines.en: : We can still be together if you choose this one...
lines.zh: : 如果你选这一个，我们还是可以在一起的……

lines.en: : I could have my daughter back...
lines.zh: : 我可以把女儿要回来……

lines.en: : You could have your light...
lines.zh: : 你可以重新拥有你的光……

lines.en: : We don’t need to be alone anymore...
lines.zh: : 我们再也不用孤单一人了……

lines.en: : And what would Kaori have?
lines.zh: : 那 Kaori 会拥有什么？

lines.en: : What more could she want when she has already received the greatest gift of all in the form of life itself?
lines.zh: : 她已经得到了最伟大的礼物 —— 生命本身，还能想要什么呢？

lines.en: : I don’t need to always be here...
lines.zh: : 我不需要一直在这里……

lines.en: : Just...sometimes.
lines.zh: : 只是……有时候。

lines.en: : Well...that would certainly make dealing with Ami easier.
lines.zh: : 嗯……那样的话，应付 Ami 确实会容易些。

lines.en: : Like you said, I’m not {i}you.{/i} I can’t fill your shoes and there’s not really much of a point in trying.
lines.zh: : 就像你说的，我不是{i}你{/i}。我穿不了你的鞋，硬要去穿也没什么意义。

lines.en: : Even so...
lines.zh: : 即便如此……

lines.en: : I’m proud of what you’ve done.
lines.zh: : 我为你做到的事感到骄傲。

lines.en: : How far you’ve come from the little boy I knew so long ago.
lines.zh: : 你已经走了多远，从我很久以前认识的那个小男孩算起。

lines.en: : Do you...
: Do you hate me, Aki-kun?
lines.zh: : 你恨我吗，Aki 君？

lines.en: scene kaorivisits23
: Do you no longer believe all I used to tell you?
lines.zh: : 你不再相信我以前告诉你的那些话了吗？

lines.en: : Has this place changed you the way it does everyone else?
lines.zh: : 这个地方是不是也像改变其他人一样，改变了你？

lines.en: : Change, huh?
lines.zh: : 改变啊？

lines.en: : Honestly, I don’t think anything or anyone has changed me since you.
lines.zh: : 老实说，我觉得自你之后，没有任何事、任何人改变过我。

lines.en: scene kaorivisits24
: Really?...
lines.zh: : 真的吗？……

lines.en: : Nothing I can pinpoint at least...
lines.zh: : 至少没有我能说得出来的……

lines.en: : There is...{i}something,{/i} though.
lines.zh: : 不过……有{i}一样东西{/i}。

lines.en: : Something like...what?
lines.zh: : 什么样的……东西？

lines.en: : A dream, almost. Just one unlike those you’ve given me. One I can’t remember, but also can’t help chasing after.
lines.zh: : 几乎像是一个梦。一个和你给我的那些都不一样的梦。一个我记不起来、却又忍不住去追逐的梦。

lines.en: : It just feels hopeless trying when I don’t know what to look for.
lines.zh: : 不知道该找什么，却还要去尝试，感觉真的很绝望。

lines.en: : Are you eating well? Sleeping well? Are you happy?
lines.zh: : 你吃得好吗？睡得好吗？你幸福吗？

lines.en: : You watch me all the time and you don’t {i}know?{/i}
lines.zh: : 你一直都在看着我，你不{i}知道{/i}吗？

lines.en: : That me isn’t always {i}me,{/i} Aki-kun. You should know that by now.
lines.zh: : 那个我并不总是{i}我{/i}啊，Aki 君。你现在该明白了。

lines.en: : Even this one, who comes to you in borrowed flesh, is little more than an echo of a girl who never was. Who lost everything before she even lost herself.
lines.zh: : 就连这个借来的躯壳、来到你面前的我，也不过是一个从未存在过的女孩的回声。她在失去自我之前，就已经失去了一切。

lines.en: : But in this moment, you know me to be real...right?
lines.zh: : 但此时此刻，你知道我是真的……对吧？

lines.en: : I miss you...
lines.zh: : 我想你……

lines.en: : I miss my daughter...
lines.zh: : 我想我的女儿……

lines.en: scene himadate31
scene kaorivisits24
: I wish I got to experience just how much she could change me.
lines.zh: : 我真希望我能亲身体会，她能把我改变多少。

lines.en: : Sekai-
lines.zh: : Sekai——

lines.en: : You still {i}can{/i} though, Aki-kun. So don’t give up on her. {i}Please.{/i}
lines.zh: : 可你{i}还有{/i}机会，Aki 君。所以别放弃她。{i}求你了{/i}。

lines.en: : She’s like her mom. Broken. Scared. Just acting strong because she thinks the world will collapse if she doesn’t.
lines.zh: : 她跟她妈妈一样。破碎。害怕。只是装得很坚强，因为她觉得如果自己不坚强，世界就会崩塌。

lines.en: : And even if you’re not {i}me,{/i} it doesn’t mean there’s {i}nothing{/i} for you to teach her.
lines.zh: : 而且就算你不是{i}我{/i}，也不代表你{i}没什么{/i}可以教她的。

lines.en: : Your love is the only love she will ever understand. Please don’t take it away...
lines.zh: : 你的爱是她唯一能理解的爱。请别把它拿走……

lines.en: : Sekai, if you’re still in there...why don’t you just talk to her?
lines.zh: : Sekai，如果你还在里面……你为什么不直接跟她说？

lines.en: scene kaorivisits25
: Like {i}this?...{/i}
lines.zh: : 像{i}这样吗{/i}？……

lines.en: : Have I not already hurt her enough?...
lines.zh: : 我伤她还不够多吗？……

lines.en: : I...I don’t-
lines.zh: : 我……我不知道——

lines.en: : Aki-kun...don’t give up. {i}Please{/i} don’t give up. Please.
lines.zh: : Aki 君……别放弃。{i}求你{/i}别放弃。求你了。

lines.en: : We need to get out of here. The longer you stay inside of Kaori, the more worried I am she won’t come back.
lines.zh: : 我们得离开这儿。你在 Kaori 身体里待得越久，我就越担心她回不来。

lines.en: : Aki-kun, {i}please.{/i}
lines.zh: : Aki 君，{i}求你了{/i}。

lines.en: : No, we’re getting up.
lines.zh: : 不行，我们得起来了。

lines.en: scene kaorivisits26
: Akira!
lines.zh: : Akira！

lines.en: scene black
: Come with me. Somewhere that isn’t going to hurt you.
lines.zh: : 跟我来。去一个不会伤害你的地方。

lines.en: : N-No! Don’t...pull me like...aah! I’m not...good at...using this body yet!
lines.zh: : 不——不要！别……这样拉我……啊！我还……不擅长……用这具身体！

lines.en: I drag her out of treachery and carry her off to somewhere between limbo and fraud.
lines.zh: 我把她从背叛中拖出来，带往一个介于炼狱与欺骗之间的地方。
